## Changelog

User-facing pull requests need a line in `CHANGELOG.md` (today's date, a
**New** / **Improved** / **Fixed** / **Under the hood** tag, a short description
of what changed for users, and a link to this PR). Skip pure internal or CI
changes, or fold them into one **Under the hood** line.

Do not include customer names, email addresses, user IDs, or other private details.

- [ ] I added a `CHANGELOG.md` entry.
- [ ] This change is internal-only, so no entry is needed.
